description: This file defines an interface 'ResourceOwnerAccessTokenInterface' within the namespace 'League\OAuth2\Client\Token'. It extends 'AccessTokenInterface' and declares a method 'getResourceOwnerId' that returns an identifier for the resource owner, if defined.

classes.name: ResourceOwnerAccessTokenInterface
classes.description: Interface for OAuth2 access tokens that can provide a resource owner identifier.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerId
methods.description: Returns the resource owner identifier if it is defined, null otherwise.
